verdict.rationale: Pendo's Leo agent is documented as monitoring continuously in the background and raising alerts in Pendo and Slack without the user going to look, which is a product-native autonomous background behavior. However, nothing shows users can define their own automations (triggers, actions, schedules) that run on their own; Leo's in-conversation actions such as building guides and segments are interactive, not background. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, recurring schedules or triggers that execute actions (not just alerts), documentation of how monitoring is set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Leo monitors continuously. Get alerts in Pendo and Slack when something shifts -without having to go looking for it.
